question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

NK-RO-VX

LI-PM-TV
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**NK : RO : VX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dfb0a250e7ffc81358fba95d0a022d29482616cf7a53471af2d01f083e5f126.png] 

**LI : PM : TV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337218c3c6066731dd92200d36926ea16415fa62afa0abf19f6a26bd68b37359.png] 

 

**Option 1: IG-NL-RU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/186d5e606bdccba6f334da21b0abe061e7d049923f6a790e4c2ff962a92a7d1c.png]

**Option 2: IG-NK-RU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/948039dea5267bf4fabf90d59f812608db44c3219bf6c20fe28ad964aaaea580.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern.

**Option 3: JG-NK-RT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3c90c0a6aec5671c458d3cc7464ad0592ff3c38ee4c0444551f8650efd693c8.png]

**Option 4: JG-NK-RU**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
